raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, exactly the 349 rows with source_tz='UTC') arrived with UTC timestamps, while all other batches are in America/Chicago local time. The pipeline casts txn_ts without any timezone handling, so about 99 Jan-16 evening Chicago transactions shift past midnight into 2026-01-17 00:00-06:00; for example, 12:01 UTC is 06:01 CST, which matches opening time.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
